description: One fixed revision (``phase_id@revision_id``) of a subsystem phase. A later issue opens a new revision, never a mutation.

entry_profile_version.description: Version of this phase's published entry criteria. It is fixed before the predecessor is accepted.
entry_profile_version.title: Entry Profile Version

nucleated_from.description: Accepted revision whose decision proposed this phase. None for a first phase.
nucleated_from.title: Nucleated From

ordinal.description: Position of the phase within its subsystem, starting at 1.
ordinal.title: Ordinal

phase_id.description: Opaque phase id, stable across revisions.
phase_id.title: Phase Id

requires_accepted.description: Predecessor revisions that must hold a scoped acceptance before this phase can leave 'possible'.
requires_accepted.title: Requires Accepted

revision_id.description: Opaque revision id of this phase.
revision_id.title: Revision Id

subsystem_id.description: Opaque subsystem id the phase belongs to.
subsystem_id.title: Subsystem Id

title: PhaseRevision
